The '''{{nihongo|YOSAKOI Festival|よさこい祭り|Yosakoi Matsuri}}''' is a summer dance festival held annually in {{ill|Kōchi (city)|en|Kōchi (city)|qid=Q207411|lt=Kōchi City}}, {{ill|Kōchi Prefecture|en|Kōchi Prefecture|qid=Q119124|lt=Kōchi Prefecture}}, since 1954. Tens of thousands of dancers in costumed teams parade through the city carrying ''naruko'' (wooden clappers), set to music incorporating phrases from the traditional folk song "Yosakoi-bushi". The Kōchi event has inspired hundreds of derivative Yosakoi-style festivals across Japan, including the [[Summer Matsuri]] tradition.
